Visit OpenSearch Dashboards
After you create a data source, OpenSearch Service provides you with an OpenSearch Dashboards
URL. You use this to conﬁgure access control, deﬁne tables, set up log-type based dashboards for
popular log types, and query your data using SQL or PPL.
For more information, see the section called “Conﬁguring a CloudWatch Logs data source”.
